name: Large Throwing Wheel
ability: After you form a Vase or Censer, gain 1 Clay.
abilityZh: 当你成型1件瓶或香炉后，获得1陶土。

name: Measuring Calipers
ability: After you form two different Shapes during the same Forming action, gain 2 Coins and 1 Clay.
abilityZh: 当你在同一次成型行动中成型了两种不同器型时，获得2铜钱与1陶土。

name: Clay Substitution
ability: Whenever you pay a Forming cost, you may pay 1 Coin instead of each 1 Clay. You may substitute any number of Clay during the same action.
abilityZh: 每当支付成型费用时，你可以用1铜钱替代每1陶土；同一次行动中可替代任意数量。

name: Drying Frames
ability: After you form a vessel, immediately apply a Glaze and Plain Decoration to that vessel without paying Coins or visiting the Glaze Workshop.
abilityZh: 你制作一件坯体后，可立即为其施釉并加上素面装饰，无需支付铜钱。

name: Carving Knives
ability: Ignore the Coin cost of one Carved Decoration you apply.
abilityZh: 忽略你施加的1次刻花装饰的铜钱费用。

name: Seal Stamps
ability: Ignore the Coin cost of one Impressed Decoration you apply.
abilityZh: 忽略你施加的1次印花装饰的铜钱费用。

name: Colour Samples
ability: When taking Orders at the Office, look at the top 2 cards of either Order deck, take 1, and place the other on the bottom of that deck.
abilityZh: 当你在贡务取得订单时，查看任一牌堆顶端2张，取1张，另1张置于牌堆底。

name: Kiln Setting
ability: Before Wood Contributions are chosen, move one of your loaded ceramics to any empty kiln space.
abilityZh: 出柴牌选定之前，将你1件已装窑的器物移至任一空的启用窑位。

name: Protective Saggars
ability: After Quality is assigned, pay 1 Coin to improve one of your ceramics by one step from Flawed to Standard or Standard to Fine.
abilityZh: 判定品第后，支付1铜钱将一件器物提升一级：次品变为合格品，或合格品变为精品。不能产生珍品。

name: Fuel Ledger
ability: When secretly committing your Wood Contribution, you may also commit Fuel Ledger: pay 1 Coin to contribute 1 additional Wood, to a maximum effective contribution of 4.
abilityZh: 选择出柴牌时，可秘密支付1铜钱使你的出柴量额外增加1，上限为4。

name: Test Pieces
ability: Before Wood Contributions are chosen, privately look at the top Fire card, then return it to the top of the deck.
abilityZh: 出柴牌选定之前，私下查看窑火牌堆顶牌，然后放回原处。

name: Kiln Records
ability: After firing, if at least one of your ceramics is a final Masterpiece, gain 1 Clay and 2 Coins.
abilityZh: 烧制全部结算后，若你至少有1件珍品，获得1陶土与2铜钱。

name: Connoisseur Network
ability: After a normal Office main action, you may sell exactly one Finished undelivered ceramic and return its Vessel: Standard 2 Coins, Fine 4 Coins, or Masterpiece 7 Coins. It cannot follow Court Patronage.
abilityZh: 在正常贡务主行动之后，可出售1件已出窑未交付的器物：合格品2铜钱、精品4铜钱、珍品7铜钱。不可接在朝廷恩荫之后。

name: Second Firing
ability: After Quality is assigned, return one of your Standard ceramics from the current firing to Glazed without a Quality.
abilityZh: 判定品第后，将你1件合格品退回施釉区并移除其品第；日后可再次烧制。

name: Sagger Selection
ability: After the Fire card is revealed, pay 2 Coins so one of your loaded ceramics treats that Fire modifier as 0.
abilityZh: 在翻开火候牌后，支付2铜钱，使其中1件你的陶瓷将该火候牌的修正视为0。
